name: Hanging Keep
description: A kraul fortress clinging to the undercity ceiling where Vraska addresses followers.

timeline.summary: Bozak reaches the Hanging Keep and consumes zombie fungus to lose his fear and climb seven stories to Vraska.
timeline.quote: I pull a zombie fungus sample from my satchel and place it on my tongue.

timeline.summary: Mazirek orders Bozak thrown out; Bozak tears his own arm free, swallows the devouring angel mushroom from Vraska's gown and leaps from the Keep.
timeline.quote: I grab the devouring angel mushroom on her gown and swallow it whole.

pages_say.description: A kraul fortress clinging to the undercity ceiling where Vraska addresses followers.
